artworks.title: Carpenter's, Mason's, Fabricator's, Repairman's, Chiropractor's, Butcher's and Baker's Place
artworks.medium: pen with black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing is one of a group of 45 drawings and 4 collages, DR1988:0291:001 - DR1988:0291:049, for John Hejduk's 'Lancaster/Hanover Masque'. These include nine large, final drawings, DR1988:0291:041 - DR1988:0291:049, in which all of the structures that constitute the masque are represented, and forty smaller sketches and collages, DR1988:0291:001 - DR1988:0291:040, mostly for individual structures. All of the drawings and collages are published and illustrated, along with Hejduk's descriptions of the structures, in 'The Lancaster/Hanover Masque' (London: Architectural Association and Montréal: CCA, 1992).

Perspectival view showing the proposed rebuilding of the Mason's Arms, Donisthorpe
artworks.artist: Henry Hyams; Thomas Jenkins; Messrs. Bindley & Co. Ltd.
artworks.description: - This building is identified as the Mason's Arms by comparison with DR1988:0380, 'Elevations for the proposed rebuilding of the Mason's Arms, Donisthorpe', which includes the elevation shown in this view. - The style of many of these drawings and reprographic copies by Henry Hyams (DR1988:0332 - DR1988:0414) suggests that they were possibly for periodical illustrations. Hyams contributed articles to the periodicals 'The Builder' and 'The Architect'. Two objects in the CCA collections can be linked to the article "Music in Stone" published prior to 1926 in 'The Architect'; a reprographic copy (DR1988:0357) and a drawing (DR1988:0364) (Who's Who in Architecture, 161).

artworks.title: Sketch site plan and sketch view of an alternative proposal for the pavilion at UNESCO Headquarters
artworks.medium: drawing in ink with graphite on translucent paper
artworks.description: - Le Corbusier prepared this drawing inscribed "reponse a lettre / de Gropius / recue le 22 Octobre 54" in response to Walter Gropius' suggestion that he too reply to a letter addressed only to Gropius by Eugene Callison, Chief engineer at UNESCO Headquarters, Paris. Callison had requested that Gropius comment on a proposal by the Zehrfuss-Breuer-Nervi team to add a pavilion to the existing UNESCO building. Le Corbusier was dissatisfied with the team's pavilion, which shows a narrow, glazed oblong raised on pilotis (Shapiro, fig. 219). He proposed instead this sketch for a detached pavilion consisting of a roughly-finished, curving wall enclosing a garden, which he sent to Callison, along with a critique of the Zehrfuss-Breuer-Nervi team's proposition. On 26 October 1954, he also sent copies of his proposal to all of the project advisors.

artworks.title: Etching of Specchi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1722
artworks.artist: Alessandro Specchi; Giovanni Battista Sintes; Holy Roman Emperor Charles VI; Girolamo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 41.2 x 54.6 cm sheet: 45.8 x 59.7 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina consists of a raised platform in front of the wall of the courtyard of the Palazzo Colonna. The platform is the same height as the wall and carrys a triumphal arch decorated with sculpture. The wall is ornamented so that it is part of the macchina, and may have been extended to the right by a temporary structure.

artworks.title: Etching of Specchi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1724
artworks.artist: Alessandro Specchi; Francesco Faraone Aquila; Pope Benedict XIII; Fabrizio Colonna; Holy Roman Emperor Charles VI
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 37.9 x 47.7 cm sheet: 42.2 x 51.9 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is built against the wall of a courtyard. The lower level of the macchina consists of a rocky cave containing mythological figures. The upper level is a small rotunda containing a statue of Victory surmounted by the Hapsburg double-headed eagle.

artworks.title: Etching of Specchi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1725
artworks.artist: Alessandro Specchi; Gasparo Massi; Holy Roman Emperor Charles VI; Fabrizio Colonna; Pope Benedict XIII
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 37.2 x 46.6 cm sheet: 41.7 x 54.8 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a two-storey fireworks construction or macchina is set against the wall of a courtyard. Above the level of the wall the macchina is is a triumphal arch which frames statues of Peace and Concord sitting arm in arm. The top of the arch is crowned with the Hapsburg double-headed eagle and the sun of Apollo.

artworks.title: Etching of Specchi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1726
artworks.artist: Alessandro Specchi; Francesco Faraone Aquila; Fabrizio Colonna; Holy Roman Emperor Charles VI; Pope Benedict XIII
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 37.2 x 46.5 cm sheet: 42.6 x 54.1 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is set against the wall of a courtyard. The central motif is a mountain surmounted by a representation of Mercury slaying a monster. The bottom of the mountain contains a cave inhabited by the Chinea, or white mare.

artworks.title: Etching of Michetti's design for the "prima macchina" of 1731
artworks.artist: Niccolò Michetti; Bartolomeo Poli; Giovanni Battista Sintes; Holy Roman Emperor Charles VI; Fabrizio Colonna; Pope Clement XII
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 38.7 x 46.0 cm sheet: 42.7 x 57.0 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is set against the courtyard wall of the Palazzo Colonna. The macchina is three stories in height: the basement level is attached to the wall of the Palazzo Colonna and includes three depictions of military scenes. The second level contains an inscription dedicated to Charles VI, Holy Roman Emperor, which is flanked by statues of Hercules and Minerva. The top level includes a statue of Atlas carrying the globe surmounted by the imperial eagle.

artworks.title: Etching of Michetti's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1731
artworks.artist: Niccolò Michetti; Bartolomeo de Pietri; Fabrizio Colonna; Holy Roman Emperor Charles VI; Pope Clement XII
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within the plate mark): 38.5 x 46 cm (15 3/16 x 18 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is set against the courtyard wall of the Palazzo Colonna. The lower level of the macchina is built against the courtyard wall of the Palazzo Colonna, while the upper level consists of a triumphal arch flanked by trophies and surmounted by the imperial eagle.

artworks.title: Etching of Michetti's design for the "prima macchina" of 1732
artworks.artist: Niccolò Michetti; Giovanni Battista Sintes; Holy Roman Emperor Charles VI; Pope Clement XII; Fabrizio Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 38.5 x 45.6 cm sheet: 39.4 x 47.7 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is set against the courtyard wall of the Palazzo Colonna. The macchina consists of a rotunda above the clouds set high up on a rocky peak. The god Jove sits under the rotunda on Mount Olympus, surrounded by gods and godesses. The print includes groups of people standing in front of the macchina, as well as a fountain dispensing wine.

artworks.title: Etching of Michetti's design for the "prima macchina" of 1733
artworks.artist: Niccolò Michetti; Giovanni Battista Sintes; Pope Clement XII; Fabrizio Colonna; Holy Roman Emperor Charles VI
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 45.7 x 36.8 cm sheet: 46.6 x 37.9 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina in the form of a triumphal arch, is surmounted with a scene of Apollo and the Muses on Mont Parnassus. The illustration also includes the Palazzo Colonna and a fountain dispensing wine.

artworks.title: Etching of Michetti's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1733
artworks.artist: Niccolò Michetti; Domenico Mariano Franceschini; Pope Clement XII; Fabrizio Colonna; Holy Roman Emperor Charles VI
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 45.5 x 36.8 cm sheet: 49.1 x 40.2 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina in the form of a triumphal arch is crowned with a scene of Jove and Minerva on Mount Olympus. The mountain is in the form of an arch, underneath which is a scene of Vulcan at his forge. The illustration includes the Palazzo Colonna to the left, and a fountain dispensing wine.

artworks.title: Etching of Hutin's design for the "prima macchina" of 1743
artworks.artist: François Hutin; Miguel de Sorelló; Francesco Scardovelli; Pope Benedict XIV; Fabrizio Colonna; Charles III, King of Spain
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.1 x 44.9 cm sheet: 44.2 x 56.3 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a painted backdrop for a fireworks display includes Venus with her son, the three Fates, and other mythological figures. The signs of the zodiac are present in the background.

artworks.title: Etching of the design for the "seconda macchina" of 1747
artworks.artist: Unknown, Italy, mid 18th century; Miguel de Sorelló; Pope Benedict XIV; Fabrizio Colonna; Giuseppe Silici; Charles III, King of Spain
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.9 x 47.4 cm sheet: 44.6 x 59.8 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina in front of the Palazzo Farnese includes the two fountains in the piazza. The macchina is a centrally-planned structure with a tower at each corner. The walls of the structure appear to be partially constructed of topiary.

artworks.title: Etching of the design for the "seconda macchina" of 1748
artworks.artist: Michelangelo Specchi; Francesco Perziado; Miguel de Sorelló; Fabrizio Colonna; Giuseppe Silici; Pope Benedict XIV; Charles III, King of Spain
artworks.medium: etching hand coloured with watercolour and white gouache
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.5 x 46.0 cm sheet: 43.9 x 51.0 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina consists of a two-storey tempietto set in a inhabited landscape. Men and women in classical dress participate in a hunt in the foreground.

artworks.title: Etching of Specchi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1749
artworks.artist: Michelangelo Specchi; Miguel de Sorelló; Pope Benedict XIV; Charles III, King of Spain; Francesco Scardovelli; Fabrizio Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 40.3 x 46.8 cm sheet: 44.0 x 59.5 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina in the form of a small single-storey tempietto is dedicated to peace. The tempietto is raised up on clouds and surrounded by various mythological figures including satyrs, and other animals such as a camel and a horse. The four women at the lower left and lower right might represent the four continents.

artworks.title: Etching of the design for the "seconda macchina" of 1749
artworks.artist: Ennemond Alexandre Petitot; Charles III, King of Spain; Fabrizio Colonna; Giuseppe Silici; Pope Benedict XIV
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 40.3 x 46.6 cm (15 7/8 x 18 3/8 in.) sheet (irreg.): 44,4 x 58,2 cm

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1751
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Fabrizio Colonna; Charles III, King of Spain; Pope Benedict XIV
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 47.7 x 35.6 cm sheet: 53.1 x 41.0 cm
artworks.description: - This etching shows a fireworks construction or macchina in the form of a triumphal arch which is raised on a basement and flanked by two columns. Inside the arch is a statue of the Roger, the first Norman King of the Two Sicilies, while the top of the arch is crowned by the arms of the current King of the two Sicilies, Charles Bourbon.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1751
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Fabrizio Colonna; Charles III, King of Spain; Pope Benedict XIV
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 47.3 x 35.7 cm sheet: 57.4 x 42.6 cm

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1753
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Benedict XIV; Fabrizio Colonna
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina in the form of an octagonal temple is dedicated to Esculapius. The macchina is flanked by fountains.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1753
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Benedict XIV; Fabrizio Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 40.7 x 57.3 cm sheet: 45.5 x 66.4 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a pavilion commemorating the munificence of the King towards his people and his troops. The pavilion is flanked by military trophies and two fountains topped by rostral columns.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1754
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Benedict XIV; Fabrizio Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 38.1 x 54.8 cm sheet: 45.7 x 66.6 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a garden pavilion, including a large central and two side fountains with running water. The pavilion is set off by four obelisks.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1755
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Pope Benedict XIV; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Fabrizio Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 38.0 x 54.7 cm sheet: 45.2 x 66.2 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a triumphal bridge with statues of the elements, commemorative columns, and a central pavilion crowned by a statue of Hercules killing a monster. People are crossing the bridge and simulated river in carriages and rowboats.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1756
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Pozzi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Lorenzo Colonna; Pope Benedict XIV
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 36.8 x 53.1 cm sheet: 43.5 x 59.1 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a triumphal arch, flanked on either side by representations of the smoking volcanoes Etna and Vesuvius.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1756
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Pozzi; Lorenzo Colonna; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Benedict XIV
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 37.1 x 53.1 cm sheet: 45.0 x 65.2 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a temple dedicated to the goddess Ceres. The central pavilion, an archway with two porticoes on both sides, is surmounted by a lattice work dome and there are two lattice gazebos on both sides of the temple.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1757
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Pozzi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Lorenzo Colonna; Pope Benedict XIV
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 36.3 x 51.8 cm sheet: 43.5 x 60.3 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is intended to resemble the portico of the Parthenon in Athens. Each of the bays of the portico is decorated with a portrait medalion of a philosopher placed on the entablature. The portico is flanked by statues of river gods.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1757
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Pozzi; Lorenzo Colonna; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Benedict XIV
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 36.3 x 53.0 cm sheet: 45.7 x 66.1 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a fortress which is meant to represent a "Cuccagna" (land of plenty) such as was created in the Two Sicilies. The fortress is decorated with trophies and with game, and is flanked by two fountains.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1758
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Pozzi; Lorenzo Colonna; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Clement XIII
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 37.7 x 52.3 cm sheet: 45.2 x 66.1 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a low wall decorated with grottos and niches. The central recession contains a statue of a river god and is crowned by trophies, a fountain, and an obelisk.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1760
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Vasi; Pope Clement XIII; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 38.6 x 53.5 cm sheet: 45.5 x 67.0 cm
artworks.description: - This etching of a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a temple dedicated to Neptune, whose statue is visible behind the portico. The temple is surmounted by a crest and is flanked by two monumental columns. Four ships appear to be engaged in a battle in the background.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1760
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Pope Clement XIII; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 38.6 x 53.5 cm sheet: 45.7 x 67.4 cm
artworks.description: - This etching of a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a pavilion with unroofed arcades extending to either side. The pavilion is roofed by a tent-like structure and is open at front and back to show a group of people gathered around a large table. The two arcades are made of palm trees: the tree trunks are the columns and their leaves form the arches. The substructure includes rooms containing animals, which are visible behind barred windows.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1761
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Vasi; Pope Clement XIII; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.2 x 54.2 cm sheet: 43.7 x 59.4 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a bathing pavilion with several fountains. The top of the pavilion is decorated with a trellis archway covered in vines.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1762
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Clement XIII; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 40.0 x 54.2 cm sheet: 40.3 x 54.6 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a stepped three-storey pavilion representing an Ottoman casino. The lower level is a dining gallery supported by rusticated piers. The cresent is used as a decorative motif throughout the pavilion.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1764
artworks.artist: Tommaso Catrani; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Clement XIII; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.7 x 53.3 cm sheet: 42.1 x 55.2 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a portico representing a Campidoglio (capitol). The foreground includes a triumphal procession based on antique reliefs.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1765
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Vasi; Pope Clement XIII; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 38.8 x 53.6 cm sheet: 45.9 x 67.0 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of an elaborate pavilion representing the Gardens of the Hesperides. The pavilion is flanked by two fountains and surrounded by water.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1765
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Lorenzo Colonna; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Clement XIII
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.0 x 53.4 cm sheet: 43.8 x 57.7 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a two-storey façade. The windows and balusters of the façade are hung with drapery like a contemporary palace for a festival. The attic storey is topped by escutcheons and fleur-de-lis. The poles on either side of the macchina are hung with game and fish.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1766
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Lorenzo Colonna; Pope Clement XIII
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.8 x 53.9 cm sheet: 45.5 x 66.5 cm

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1764
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Vasi; Lorenzo Colonna; Pope Clement XIII; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.7 x 53.9 cm sheet: 45.3 x 66.5 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a pavilion curved around a semi-circular space creating a "stage" area in which men are engaged in wrestling.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1767
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Vasi; Lorenzo Colonna; Pope Clement XIII; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.9 x 54.1 cm sheet: 41.6 x 55.5 cm

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1769
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Lorenzo Colonna; Pope Clement XIV; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.8 x 54.5 cm sheet: 44.5 x 60.0 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a two-storey garden pavilion flanked by four obelisks. The representation includes trees and two fountains in the background and a herd of oxen in the foreground.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1769
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Clement XIV; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a central two-storey pavilion with a single storey shop front on either side. The construction is raised on a platform and backed by a stone wall.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1770
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Clement XIV; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 41.0 x 56.6 cm sheet: 44.2 x 59.9 cm
artworks.description: - This etching is for a fireworks construction or macchina in the form of a pavilion, with stands for musicians on either side. The lower level of the apparatus includes a picture gallery while the upper storey consists of one large and four small gazebos enclosed with paned glass. The central gazebo is surmounted by a globe depicting an unidentified continent.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1770
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Pope Clement XIV; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 40.9 x 57.8 cm sheet: 42.6 x 57.8 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a pavilion, with stands for musicians on either side. The lower level of the macchina represents a series of fish stalls and the architecture is deliberately rusticated, with cracks in the masonry and vines growing on the arches. The upper level consists of one large and four small canopies held up with columns wrapped with wreaths.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1771
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Lorenzo Colonna; Pope Clement XIV
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 40.0 x 55.3 cm sheet: 45.5 x 67.3 cm

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1771
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Clement XIV; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.6 x 55.1 cm sheet: 44.5 x 60.6 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is dedicated to Bacchus. The central pavilion contains a statue of Bacchus seated on a wine keg and the attic level consists of a trellis covered in grape vines. To either side of the central pavilion ruined archways frame scenes of people pressing grapes.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1772
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Lorenzo Colonna; Pope Clement XIV; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.5 x 53.7 cm sheet: 45.8 x 67.4 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is dedicated to Chinese philosophy. The macchina is in the form of a wall articulated with a specially designed order of architecture. The capitals of the order consist of two dragons looking in opposite directions. Statues representing chinese philosophers are placed between the columns.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1772
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Clement XIV; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 39.5 x 53.5 cm sheet: 46.5 x 66.5 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina represents a game market constructed in the form of a two-storey wall with a central archway. Shops selling game are separated by a giant order of rusticated columns.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1773
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Clement XIV; Lorenzo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 38.3 x 51.6 cm sheet: 46.0 x 67.2 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a temple dedicated to peace. The temple appears to be centrally-planned, consisting of a square lower story crowned by a shallow dome similar to that of the Pantheon except that is roofed with fish-scale shingles. The front façade is in the form of a triumphal arch.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1773
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Vasi; Lorenzo Colonna; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Clement XIV
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 38.5 x 51.7 cm sheet: 45.5 x 67.0 cm
artworks.description: - This etching of a fireworks construction or macchina represents a public celebration of the making of a poison antidote "che si fà nella Città di Venezia" (as it is done in Venice). The macchina consists of a pavilion raised on a base. The pavilion appears to be square, with a central opening a large smoking vat of theriaca. The top storey appears to be octagonal and is crowned by a tent. The relief on the front of the octagon shows a view of the Piazza San Marco and the Doge's Palace from the Molo.

artworks.title: Etching of Posi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1774
artworks.artist: Paolo Posi; Giuseppe Palazzi; Giuseppe Vasi; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Clement XIV; Lorenzo Colonna

artworks.title: Etching of Palazzi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1782

artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 52.7 x 38.4 cm sheet: 64.5 x 45.2 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a tempietto (small temple) set in a rocky landscape and surrounded by contemporary and classically-dressed figures.

artworks.title: Etching of Palazzi's design for the "seconda macchina" of 1782

artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 52.6 x 38.5 cm sheet: 65.0 x 46.2 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a garden pavilion. The columns of the first storey of the pavilion are decorated with garlands, and garlands and drapes are hung in all the openings.

artworks.title: Etching of Palazzi's design for the "prima macchina" of 1785
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Palazzi; Francesco Barbazza; Ferdinand I, King of the Two Sicilies; Pope Pius VI; Filippo Colonna
artworks.dimensions: plate mark: 51.5 x 37.5 cm sheet: 67.5 x 46.5 cm
artworks.description: - This etching for a fireworks construction or macchina is in the form of a temple dedicated to Jove, Juno, and Minvera. The central bay of the temple is surmounted by an attic storey and a pediment, while the two side bays have projecting porticos and low domes. Statues of Juno, Jove, and Minverva crown each bay from left to right respectively.

artworks.title: St. Peter's Home, Woking: Heating plan for the north portion of the new wing
artworks.artist: Frank Loughborough Pearson; Office of Frank Loughborough Pearson
artworks.description: - This drawing shows a ground plan and first floor plan in graphite, with pipes and radiators indicated in red pencil. - This work is part of a group of drawings and reprographic prints of drawings for St. Peter's Home, Woking, and St. Peter's Convent, Woking, from the offices of John Loughborough Pearson and Frank Loughborough Pearson (DR1989:0015:011 - DR1989:0015:085 R/V). Composed of contract and working drawings including plans, site plans, sections, and elevations dated between 1881 and 1936, these drawings were sold at auction by the convent along with those for the older institution of St. Peter's Home, Kilburn (DR1989:0015:001 - DR1989:0015:010). Both St. Peter's Home, Kilburn, and St. Peter's Home, Woking were commissioned from John Loughborough Pearson by Benjamin Lancaster. The alterations to the Home at Kilburn were commissioned on behalf of Lancaster's wife, who founded the home and a lay nursing order which ran it. The institution at Woking was founded by Lancaster as a home for incurables in 1882 and dedicated to the memory of his deceased wife (Quiney 67-68, 254-255, and 284). It was probably first known as St. Peter's Home, Woking, not becoming a convent until ca. 1934.

artworks.description: - This work is part of a group of drawings and reprographic copies of drawings for St. Peter's Home, Woking, and St. Peter's Convent, Woking, from the offices of John Loughborough Pearson and Frank Loughborough Pearson (DR1989:0015:011 - DR1989:0015:085 R/V). Composed of contract and working drawings including plans, site plans, sections, and elevations dated between 1881 and 1936, these drawings were sold at auction by the convent along with those for the older institution of St. Peter's Home, Kilburn (DR1989:0015:001 - DR1989:0015:010). Both St. Peter's Home, Kilburn, and St. Peter's Home, Woking were commissioned from John Loughborough Pearson by Benjamin Lancaster. The alterations to the Home at Kilburn were commissioned on behalf of Lancaster's wife, who founded the home and a lay nursing order which ran it. The institution at Woking was founded by Lancaster as a home for incurables in 1882 and dedicated to the memory of his deceased wife (Quiney 67-68, 254-255, and 284). It was probably first known as St. Peter's Home, Woking, not becoming a convent until ca. 1934.

A survey plan of Blenheim Park
artworks.artist: John Spyers; Sir John Vanbrugh; Bartholomew Peisley III; John Armstrong; Unknown, Great Britain, 18th century; Henry Wise; William Townesend; George Spencer, Duke of Marlborough; Lancelot Brown
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with watercolour over graphite on laid paper plume et encre noire et brune avec aquarelle sur crayon graphite, sur papier vergé
artworks.description: - DR1985:0416 records, in the form of a measured survey, the state of Blenheim Park in 1763, i.e., immediately before the modifications made by Capability Brown. According to this survey, the components and the layout of the park at that date corresponded closely to the original design (1705-16) published in `Vitruvius Britannicus III' (1725), pls. 72-73: the Grand Bridge, the kitchen garden, the tree-lined rides, the Grand Avenue, and the park plantations appear pretty much as their designers intended. However, DR1985:0416 also indicates that the military or state garden at the rear of the palace, with its great parterre and bastioned walls, was already more than half destroyed, and that a lake and a canal system comprised of three arms then existed at the front and to the south-east side of the palace. These important features, the histories of which are poorly documented, were entirely suppressed in the course of Brown's alterations.

artworks.title: Design for a triumphal arch
artworks.artist: Unknown Northern European Artist, active early 16th century
artworks.description: This print shows a heavily ornamented triumphal arch leading to vaulted corridor. Pairs of columns on either side of the portal have Corinthian capitals and fluted shafts sit atop non-canonical urn-like bases. The corridor that recedes into the distance has quadripartite vaults. The entablature features two male profile portrait rondels surrounded by laurel leaves. The frieze includes putti, arabesques, and grotesques. The attic story has two urns on either side of a central fronton with a Latin inscription evoking the mythical city of Troy and the date of execution, 1534. These elements are also covered in grotesques. At the top, an empty cartouche is flanked by two cornucopia and two additional vases/urns.

artworks.description: Triumphal arch flanked by two pairs of fluted Doric columns that have capitals ornamented with grotesques. The arch leads to a coffered barrel vault and grotesques covering both sides of the interior walls. The entablature is also Doric, with metopes featuring bovine skulls and alternating circular ornaments. In the attic story is a quadrilateral cartouche with a Latin inscription that reads “MVLTA RENAS CENTVR QVE NVNCCECIDERE.” On either side of the cartouche are arabesques with anthropomorphic feet and vases/urns that are also decorated with grotesque ornamentation. Above is a series of three scalloped niches. The central niche uses a highly ornamental Corinthian order below a triangular pediment.

artworks.artist: J. Jopling; John Douglas Sutherland Campbell, Duke of Argyll; Princess Louise
artworks.medium: watercolour and pen and black ink
artworks.dimensions: comp.: 45.0 x 34.0 cm mat: 61.6 x 50.7 cm secondary support: 55.6 x 43.0 cm sheet: 33.9 x 23.9 cm
artworks.description: - This watercolour rendering depicts a welcome arch which spans the intersection of two streets. The arch is composed of a large central groin vaulted archway and four smaller groin vaulted archways. The central archway is supported by four compound piers and is surmounted by a dome on a drum. The smaller archways which are surmounted by turrets, span the sidewalks at the street corners and are each supported by a compound pier and three columns. The structure is embellished with Gothic-inspired features such as blind tracery and pointed arches as well as shields, including two inscribed with the letter "L", flags, floral garlands, the British royal coat of arms, a sheaf of wheat and possibly lights. Staffage indicates the large scale of the arch.

The central archway is surmounted by a dome on a drum and the entire structure is supported by four rows of columns. The arch is embellished with Gothic-inspired features such as blind tracery and pointed arches as well as shields, including two inscribed with the letter "L", flags, floral garlands, the British royal coat of arms, and possibly lights. Staffage indicates the large scale of the arch.

artworks.description: This unbound album comprises 42 plates and title pages and a list of plates (as follows): Le Nouvel Opéra de Paris. Sculpture ornementale Le Nouvel Opéra de Paris. Sculpture ornementale. Chapiteaux, tympans, panneaux, médaillons, masques, cartouches, pilastres, couronnements, clefs, frises, consoles, motifs divers d'ornementation par Charles Garnier, architecte, membre de l'Institut D et Cie, Paris, Librairie Générale de l'Architecture et des Travaux Publics, Ducher et Cie, Éditeurs, 51, rue des Écoles, 51, 1875. Table des Planches 1. - Médaillons - Tympans des arcades du rez-de-chaussée (façade principale). 2. - Cartouche couronnant les pilastres du grand vestibule. 3. - Cartouche servant d'applique sur les piliers du vestibule circulaire. 4. - Tables saillantes. - Galeries latérales du grand escalier. 5. - Table saillante. artworks.title: Album of views of cities and towns showing public, religious and domestic architecture, Ottoman Empire (now in Lebanon, Syria, Turkey and Israel)
artworks.medium: albumen silver prints from paper negatives
artworks.dimensions: album (closed): 46,2 x 61,4 x 3,8 cm comps. (range): 19,7 to 28,2 x 18,3 to 113,6 cm pages (range): 45,4 to 59,2 x 45,5 to 118,1 cm
artworks.description: Album PH1980:0048.01:001-0049 comprises 49 views of the Ottoman Empire, including views of subjects which are now located in Lebanon, Syria, Turkey, and Israel. The 24 views of Lebanon include ten views of Tripoli, eight of Baalbek, four of Beirut and two of Jubayl. The photographs show: eight cityscapes; seven views of temples; three views of mosques; 2 views of towers; and one view each of a convent, the ruins of a castle, the foundations of a Phoenician building, and the Consulate General of France in Beirut. The 12 views of Syria include seven views of Damascus, two of Jebel ed Druz, two of Tartus and one view of Latakia. The photographs show: three views of Jewish houses; two views of the ruins of a Roman amphitheater; two views of the French Consulate in Damascus; and one view each of a Christian house, the ruins of a castle, a church, a cityscape and a city gate. The seven views of Turkey include six views of Antioch and one view of Seleucia Pieria (both now Antakya). The photographs show: three views of fortifications; and one view each of a city gate, a statue, a cityscape and the entry to the Iron Canyon. The six views of Israel include two views of Acre, two of Mount Carmel and one view each of Haifa and Nazareth. The photographs show three cityscapes, and one view each of batteries, a convent and a palace.

artworks.title: Cost estimates, projected rental incomes, and a site plan for an opera house for the Théâtre Royal Italien and surrounding infrastructure on the Ministère des Affaires Étrangères and the Hôtel du Timbre site
artworks.medium: transfer lithograph with pen and brown ink
artworks.description: Manuscript DR1974:0002:036:006:001-006 documents a project in which the Ministère des Affaires Étrangères would apparently retain the property of its archives and the Hôtel d'Etchegoyan. The project proposes the creation of a new street to provide access to the rear of the opera house and to isolate it from the Ministère des Affaires Étrangères. The principal façade of the opera house was to be on the property of the Hôtel du Timbre facing rue de la Paix. The manuscript includes proposed construction costs and rental income for the opera house, including its boutiques and café, and the adjacent shopping arcades, apartments, and houses.

artworks.title: Perspectif de l'église et du presbytère de Notre-Dame-Auxiliatrice à Verdun, Québec
artworks.medium: mine de plomb sur papier calque
artworks.description: Bien que le dessin ne soit pas signé il peut être attribué à Dutrisac sur la base d'une autre dessin signé de sa main, identique autant dans la manière que la technique à celui pour N.-D. Auxiliatrice. Il s'agit d'une perspective pour l'église et le presbytère de Notre-Dame-de-la-Garde, Verdun, publiée en 1948 dans la revue Architecture, Batiment, Construction (vol.3, no. 22, féviere 1948, p. 21). Quant à la date de 1940 attribuée au dessin, nous l'avons donnée en fonction de la date de mise en chantier de l'église cette année là.

artworks.description: "Le Centre du Commerce international à l'Expo 67 / Ce pavillon, commandité par les banques à charte du Canada dont chacune y tient son propre bureau, est doté d'un grand bar-salon où se déroulent les principales activités de l'Expo-club, lieu de rencontre des hommes d'affaires canadiens et étrangers. / The International Trade Centre at Expo 67 / This pavilion, which houses the Business Development Bureau, was sponsored by the Chartered Banks of Canada. It is designed to afford businessmen of the world an opportunity to meet their Canadian counterparts. Each of the Chartered Banks have offices in the building, which also provides Expo club, a meeting place for Canadian and world businessmen."--Description.

artworks.artist: Affleck, Desbarats, Dimakopoulos, Lebensold, Sise; May Cutler
artworks.description: "Le pavillon thématique illustrant 'L'Homme à l'oeuvre' dans l'Ile Notre-Dame brille vraiment de tous ces feux, à la tombée du jour. Cet ensemble de pavillons comme d'ailleurs celui qui illustre 'L'Homme interroge l'Univers', dans l'Ile Sainte-Hélène acquiert de plus en plus une réputation d'excellence, à cause de ses éléments d'exposition. / The theme pavilion devoted to Man the Producer occupies a site facing the Expo Express station on Ile Notre-Dame. Its sections are designed in the shape of truncated tetrahedrons. The pavilion has four levels. The main exhibits entitled 'Resources for Man', 'Progress' and 'Man in Control' are confined to the second and fourth levels. The ground floor contains restaurants and other services, while the third level constitutes a plaza leading to all exhibits."--Description.

artworks.artist: Duffus, Romans, Single & Kundzins; Ojars Biskaps; Douglas Shadbolt; May Cutler
artworks.description: "Atlantic Provinces at Expo 67 -- The underlying theme of the pavilion is the identification of the Atlantic provinces with the Atlantic Ocean, illustrated by large marine objects including a channel buoy and a mast with naval flags, halyards and jackstay. A major exhibit will be a yacht under construction designed along the lines of a coastal schooner. There are restaurant facilities for more than 200, including a Chowder Bar. / Les quatre provinces canadiennes de l'Atlantique, l'île [sic] du Prince-Edouard, la Nouvelle-Ecosse, le Nouveau-Brunswick et Terre-Neuve ont un pavillon commun à l'Expo 67. L'une des attractions de ce pavillon est la construction, sur place, d'un navire."--Description.

Les éléments d'exposition expriment la tradition d'intégrité et d'indépendance de l'Etat. The pavilion features a 12-foot statue of the explorer, Samuel de Champlain."--Description.

artworks.description: "Le Pavillon de la République de Chine à l'Expo 67 ...... Le Pavillon de la République de Chine exprime on ne peut mieux le sourire et la grâce de l'Orient. L'architecture traditionnelle du bâtiment renferme des éléments d'expositions qui veulent illustrer le rôle de ce pays sur la Terre des Hommes. / Republic of China Pavilion at Expo 67 ..... The two-stories Chinese pavilion on Ile Sainte-Hélène features the traditional architecture of that country. A display of world famous Chinese handicraft work is a special attraction."--Description.

Its intricate structure was effected by extremely accurate positioning of over 60 variations of triangular aluminum panels into their supporting extruded framework."--Description.

artworks.description: "Que les pavillons soient petits ou grands, ils apportent l'atmosphère du pays qu'ils représentent. Le pavillon de la Barbade et de la Guyane en est un exemple. / Barbados and Guyana Pavilion at Expo 67 ----- The joint pavilion of Barbados and Guyana is on Ile Notre-Dame. Though both countries participate under the same roof, there are separate exhibits emphasizing the individual contributions of each country to the story of mankind. Barbados coral stone and Guyana woods form basic materials for the pavilion. There is a bar with an exotic tropical setting specializing in drinks made with Barbados and Demerara rum."--Description.

The many facets of Algeria are presented with an accent on education, industrial development and the exploitation of natural resources."--Description.

artworks.title: View of the Cuban Pavilion, Expo 67, Montréal, Québec
artworks.artist: Simonne Daigneault; Baroni, Garatti, Da Costa; Gagnon & Rousseau; May Cutler
artworks.description: "Superposition of parallelipipeds and other geometrical shapes makes the Cuban Pavilion rather complicated visually. Structurally, however, it is designed to be easily dismantled and reassembled in Cuba after Expo. That is why over 40 tons of Alcan aluminum sheet were used in its construction."--Description.

Le pavillon de la Birmanie est de construction typiquement Birmane: son décor de laques et de sculptures sur bois aux motifs floraux en ont fait un endroit exotique où il fait bon se rencontrer. Le pavillon a d'ailleurs comme thème: l'Homme et l'amitié. / Burma's Pavilion at Expo 67 ........ Traditional Burmese architecture with decorations of elaborate floral wood carving and lacquered paintings are featured in the design of this pavilion on Ile Notre-Dame."--Description.

artworks.artist: Bryan Elliott Limited; George F. Eber; May Cutler
artworks.description: "Les Jamaicains ont fait construire à l'Expo 67 un pavillon, réplique fascinante de ces célèbres auberges du siècle dernier, qui ont fait la renommée du pays auprès des estivants. Erigé sur une sorte de presqu'île dans l'Ile Notre-Dame, le pavillon de la Jamaique est voisin du pavillon des Indiens du Canada et de celui de Monaco. / Jamaica bringsto [sic] Expo 67 a classic Jamaican inn, a reproduction of one of the many inns that served the islanders and visitors in the late 18th and 19th centuries. Situated on Ile Notre-Dame, the inn has a shingled roof, shuttered upper windows and an elegant courtyard. Smaller thatched buildings on the perimeter are reminiscent of those on the old sugar plantations."--Description.

artworks.artist: Jodin, Lamarre, Pratte & Carrière; Desrochers & Dumont Architects; May Cutler
artworks.description: "Les éléments d'exposition du pavillon que la république de Haiti fait construire à l'Expo 67 illustreront le thème 'Haiti, terre de soleil'. L'édifice sera situé dans l'Ile Notre-Dame, à proximité des pavillons de Monaco et de la Yougoslavie. Il se reflétera dans deux des canaux de l'Expo. / The pavilion of the Republic of Haiti will stress the theme 'Haiti... land of the sun,' and will be located on Notre-Dame near the pavilions of Monaco and Yugoslavia. The pavilion's floor and external terrace will be a checkered motif stylizing the sun, while the roof will be made of 16 hollow tubes of varying heights. Total cost of the pavilion will be approximately $150,000.00."--Description.

artworks.description: "Pavillon du Japon / Le pavillon du Japon allie le passé au présent sous le thème: "Le Japon en progrès"[.] On y sert le thé dans un décor de plantes tropicales et de jeux d'eau. / Japanese Pavilion at Expo 67 / This modern interpretation of traditional Japanese architecture contains exhibits of the life, art, and industry of Japan. Three exhibit buildings at descending levels lead down to a Japanese garden and restaurant. The pavilion is on the Ile Sainte-Helene riverbank facing the Montreal skyline."--Description.

artworks.artist: Mansinh M. Rana; Marshall, Merrett, Stahl, Elliott, and Mill; May Cutler
artworks.description: "Le Pavillon de l'Inde à l'Expo 67 ----- Situé dans l'île [sic] Notre-Dame, le Pavillon Indien illustre par son contenu l'influence que l'Inde a exercée sur des peuples aussi civilisés que les Grecs, les Romains et les Arabes. Le visiteur constatera l'effort d'un pays qui veut marquer l'époque actuelle d'une civilisation aussi belle que l'ancienne. / Pavillon of India -------- The rich traditions and diverse languages, costumes, religions and customs of India are exhibited in a magnificent pavilion on Ile Notre-Dame. Special attractions include famous bronzes and Mughal paintings, weapons, drums, jewelry, pictorial panorama, changing gallery of modern art, music and dance."--Description.

artworks.description: "Le Pavillon de la Tunisie à l'Expo '67 / Le Pavillon de la Tunisie est de forme rectangulaire. Sa façade est blanche, ornée à la base de carreaux de faïence bleue. Les sections intérieures de ce bâtiment, se groupent autour d'un patio à colonnades, dont le sol est recouvert d'une mosaïque romaine authentique. L'artisanat, le tourisme, l'agriculture et l'industrie composent le thème de ce pavillon qui est aussi doté d'un restaurant où sont servis des mets tunisiens, ainsi que d'un café maure. / Tunisian Pavilion at Expo '67 / The white facade and blue porcelain tile flooring of the Tunisian pavilion are reminiscent of Tunisia's ancient Arab palaces. In this authentic setting craftsmen perform traditional trades, beating copper and making carpets by hand. A Moorish cafe and restaurant are also features of the pavilion."--Description.

artworks.artist: Eliot Noyes & Associates; Donaldson, Drummond & Sankey; May Cutler
artworks.description: "Pavillon des Nations Unies à l'Expo 67 ......... Le drapeau des Nations Unies et ceux des 122 membres de l'organisation entourent le bâtiment circulaire construit en béton, en acier et en verre du pavillon des Nations-Unies. Un théâtre intérieur permet de voir des films sur les principaux problèmes du monde [d']aujourd'hui. / United Nations Pavilion at Expo 67 ...... Above the circular pavilion of the United Nations, built of concrete, steel and glass, the 122 flags of member nations gently swell in the breezes of the St. Lawrence River."--Description.

artworks.description: "Le Pavillon de la Thailande à l'Expo 67 / Le pavillon de la Thaïlande comprend deux édifices, dont la réplique d'un temple bouddhique d'environ 80 pieds de hauteur. Construit par des artisans thaïlandais à Bangkok même, ce somptueux palais doré a été assemblé dans l'ïle [sic] Notre-Dame. L'ensemble du pavillon comporte en outre un bâtiment cruciforme de même inspiration, quoique de style plus moderne, à l'intérieur duquel on a aménagé un restaurant et une salle d'exposition. En contrebas du pavillon, les visiteurs peuvent admirer une réplique de la célèbre barque royale ancrée dans une pièce d'eau. / Thailand Pavilion at Expo '67 / The main building of the Thailand pavilion is a fine reproduction of an 18th century Buddhist Shrine with a roof of gilded tiles and a towering spire. Both ancient and modern Thailand have their place in the display, and there are exhibits of fine art, handicrafts and other aspects of the culture of the country."--Description.

artworks.title: View of the Pavilion of the Jeunesses Musicales of Canada, Expo 67, Montréal, Québec
artworks.description: "Le Pavillon des Jeunesses Musicales à l'Expo '67 / Vue du pavillon des Jeunesses Musicales du Canada. L'édifice permanent de $250,000 est commandité par la Portland Cement Association en collaboration avec les J.M.C. A la fin de l'Exposition, le pavillon sera démonté et transporté au village des J.M.C. au Mont Orford, dans les Cantons de L'Est, où il sera reconstruit. / Jeunesses Musicales Pavilion at Expo '67 / This concrete paneled pavilion in Cité du Havre contains exhibits on music in Canada from 1610 and on systems for the musical education of the young. An opportunity to listen to Canadian works and a studio where leading musicians direct practice sessions for students also form part of the display. The world congress of the Jeuneses Musicales International Federation will be held here in mid-summer."--Description.

artworks.artist: Ouellet Reeves & Alain, Architects; May Cutler
artworks.description: "Légende / Douze éléments thématiques, répartis autour d'une esplanade carrée, appelée l'agora, serviront à présenter le thème du Pavillon de la Jeunesse à l'Expo 67. Le pavillon aura également un théâtre de 250 places, un amphithéâtre en plein air et un café-dansant. Ces installations serviront à présenter une gamme très variée d'activités culturelles, sportives et divertissantes, qui seront toutes commanditées par Steinberg Limitée."--Description.

artworks.title: View of the Man in the Community Pavilion from Habitat 67, Expo 67, Montréal, Québec
artworks.description: "Le Pavillon de l'homme dans la Cité à l'Expo 67 ... Le pavillon de l'Homme dans la Cité est un pavillon conique dont la structure est un treillis de poutres de bois des côtes du Pacifique. De l'extérieur, le pavillon rappelle la forme des édifices religieux de l'Asie, ou une fusée. / Man in the Community at Expo 67 ... Civilized man's existence includes the idea of the City and this idea is examined in a magnificent pavilion made of spruce and fir beams laid in hexagons of diminishing size."--Description.

artworks.title: View of a model of the Youth Pavilion, Expo 67, Montréal, Québec
artworks.artist: Ouellet Reeves & Alain, Architects; May Cutler
artworks.description: "Caption / Displays and exhibits in the Expo '67 Youth Pavilion will be housed in 12 thematic modules surrounding an open square or 'agora'. The agora, along with a 250-seat theatre, open-air amphitheatre and 'café-dansant', will be used for a wide range of cultural, social and athletic events, all sponsored by Steinberg's Limited."--Description.

The drawing illustrates the discrete elements of an exhibition involving several large-scale installations. One of these installations shows a crane on which a net filled with mannequins is suspended; the mannequins are painted black, in the words of the designers, to represent the impacts of oil spills on the global population. This image, however, suggests violence beyond environmental disasters.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 173: Caserta/ Fam. Sintra
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches and notes for the Proposta para Caserta, Italy and the Banco Borges & Irmão II in Vila do Conde, Portugal.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 237: Moves - C.A.
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the J.M. Teixeira house in Guimarães, Portugal, and for the Punt and Komma social housing. It also contains sketches of furniture and people.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 269: Madrid 1º Idea - Alcoy - Santiago - Arousa
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the Galician Centre of Contemporary Art in Santiago de Compostela, for the Vilanova de Arousa Sport complex in Spain, for the Reconstruction of Portal di Riquer in Alcoy, for the La Defensa Cultural Centre in Madrid, and for the Library of the University of Aveiro in Portugal.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 273: Moledo - Famalição - V. Nova Arousa
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes notes about the Galician Centre of Contemporary Art in Santiago de Compostela and the Centro Cultural de la Defensa in Madrid, Spain. It also contains sketches of people.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 286: Candeeiros Rua- Sevilha - Aveiro Gimn.. - Casa Cadiz
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the Library of the University of Aveiro in Portugal, the Guardiola house in Puerto de Santa Maria, Spain, the Galeria Carvalho Araújo in Lisbon, the Vilanova de Arousa Sport complex, and for the Housing in Concepción Arenal in Cadiz. There is also mention of the Casa de Chá da Boa Nova and the Piscina das Marés, as well as sketches of lighting fixtures.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 292: Texto Baixa - Fac. Arq.ra Jardins-Madrid- Museu Porto II-Cadiz I -Sevilha Jardim Sicilia-Alcoy
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the reconstruction of Portal di Riquer in Alcoy, Spain, and for the reconstruction of the Chiado. It also contains sketches of a garden in Seville, people, and furniture, as well as notes for the Housing in Concepción Arenal in Cadiz, Guardiola house in Puerto de Santa Maria, Santo Domingo de Bonaval Park in Santiago de Compostela, Vilanova de Arousa Sport complex, and Olympic Village Meteorological Centre and MOPU delegation headquarters in Barcelona.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 295: Museu Madrid
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches and notes for the Library of the University of Aveiro, Portugal, and for the Centro Cultural de la Defensa in Madrid, Spain. It also contains sketches of people.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 296: Madrid
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches and notes for the Library of the University of Aveiro, Portugal, and for the Centro Cultural de la Defensa in Madrid, Spain. It also contains sketches of people.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 312: Pr. Espanha - Paris - Troia - Boavista
artworks.description: This sketchbook contains notes and sketches of the Boavista building in Portugal, the Urban plan for city centre in Montreuil, France, and the Casa Pereira Ganhão in Tróia, Portugal.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 330: Grandela - Boavista 2 - Puxadores
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches and notes for the Urban plan for Boulevard Brune in Paris, France and the reconstruction of Chiado in Lisbon, Portugal. It also contains portraits and design of furniture.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 332: Chiado - Rossio Evora - S. Roque
artworks.description: This sketchbook contains sketches and notes of the reconstruction of the Chiado in Lisbon, including the Camara Chaves building, as well as sketches of Quinta da Malagueira in Évora, Portugal.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 333: Haia - Aveiro - Uma Igreja
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes notes, sketches of people, animals, and of the Olympic Village Meteorological Centre and MOPU delegation headquarters in Spain,

artworks.title: Sketchbook 366: Serralves - Evora
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the Museum of Contemporary Art of the Serralves Foundation, the children's education centre in the Serralves Park in Porto, as well as for the Master plan for Rossio São Brás in Évora, Portugal.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 384: Aga Khan Lisboa
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the Ismaili Centre and Aga Khan Foundation in Lisbon, Portugal and for the Rectory of the University of Alicante in Spain.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 392: Serralves - Penafiel - Granada - Veneza
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the Edificio Zaida in Granada, Spain and for the Ceramic Terrain housing and office in Maastricht, The Netherlands. It also contains sketches for the lettering of the Library of the University of Aveiro in Portugal and notes about Venice.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 410: Amsterdam - Expo - Ballet
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the restoration and extension of Stedelijk Museum.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 418: Metro Porto
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the Santa Maria church and parish centre in Marco de Canavezes, Portugal, as well as for the Competition for Porto Underground. It also notes in english.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 414: I Caorle - I Boavista 2 final - Casa Douro - I Aroeira
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches of unidentified projects.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 425: Praga - Chave Medidas Serralves - Salonica
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the Caorle Town hall in Italy. It also includes sketches of peole on horses and animals.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 437: Vigo Gimno
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the Multiuse Pavilion in Vigo and the Multipurpose pavilion in Gondomar.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 447: Rosario - Roma - Valencia
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes notes for a presentation and sketches for the Centro Municipal no Distrito Sud in Rosario, Argentina, and for a project in Valencia, Spain. It also contains sketches of people.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 464: Escultura
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the Chapel of the Casa Manuel Silva in Quinta de Santo Ovidio, Lousada, and for the Portugal pavilion of the Expo’98 in Lisbon, Portugal. It also contains sketches of people and of a sculpture.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 465: Capela Lousada
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the Chapel of the Casa Manuel Silva in Quinta de Santo Ovidio, Lousada, Portugal. It also contains sketches of a bus shelter, working details, man on a horse, animals, and people.

artworks.title: Sketchbook 520: Peniche
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the New Orleans building in Rotterdam, The Netherland, and for the Pousada, Fort Peniche in Portugal. It also contains notes for the Faculty of education sciences of the Cappont University in Lérida, Spain

artworks.title: Sketchbook 462: Evora - Igreja Lousada - Felgueiras
artworks.description: This sketchbook includes sketches for the Santa Maria church and parish centre in Marco de Canavezes, the Chapel of the Casa Manuel Silva in Quinta de Santo Ovidio, Lousada, as well as for Bonjour Tristesse in Berlin, Germany. It also contains sketches of a man on a horse, notes from a meeting with the Gabinete do Chiado (14/05/1999) and notes from a speech at the Universidade Lusíada.
